title: Grand Unification Builds the Stage, Not the Script
content: Grand unified theories are justified by the claim that a larger group explains more, but that claim has never been given a number. We define the exact reach of a unified model as the number of relations among low-energy observables that hold for every admissible choice of Yukawa matrices and vacuum expectation values, so that nothing is fitted. At the renormalisable level, for the standard Higgs contents of \( \mathrm{SU}(5) \), \( \mathrm{SO}(10) \), \( E_6 \) and Pati-Salam, the reach splits into a baseline-gauge-coupling unification and charge quantisation, three relations for a simple group and one for Pati-Salam-and a model-specific part. Across the eighteen contents that part takes only the values zero and one. It is zero for five of the six contents that do not force the down-quark and charged-lepton spectra to be proportional, and it equals one for the sixth, \( \mathrm{SO}(10) \) with \( \mathbf{120}+\mathbf{126} \). The asymmetric Yukawa coupling \( \mathbf{120} \) is the only source of any excess at all. Where it does not kill the model outright by making \( M_e=M_d^{\mathsf T} \), it fixes the charged-lepton matrix rigidly, \( M_e=-2M_d-M_d^{\mathsf T} \), and that single constraint yields a parameter-free bound, \( 1<\sum m_e^2/\sum m_d^2\le9 \), which the observed unification-scale spectrum satisfies. Contents that exceed the baseline by more than one are already excluded. The unified group fixes the stage; the flavour sector, not the group, writes the script.
